work_schedule._note: Python date.weekday(): Monday=0 ... Sunday=6. Remote = Mon, Fri.

trip_shape._note: Depart Wed/Thu/Fri evening (after the workday). Return Sun/Mon/Tue evening. weekday(): Wed=2 Thu=3 Fri=4 Sun=6 Mon=0 Tue=1.

pto_buying._note: A PTO-buying window is only surfaced if it clears this nights-per-PTO-day bar, so a 1-night-per-PTO-day trip never shows up next to the free 4-night baseline.

alerts._note: drop_pct_threshold: notify when a fare drops this fraction below its own 30-day median for that exact window.

amadeus._note: Requires AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID / AMADEUS_CLIENT_SECRET env vars for the live (production) API host, not the test host. See SKILL.md.
